description: CONTRACT_SPEC.md §6.5 step 4: an envelope with a valid magic + version but an inactive alg_id (0x10, a reserved PQC slot per §6.2) rejects with VersionError 'envelope_algorithm_unsupported'.
notes: alg_id 0x10 is a reserved-not-active PQC registry slot per CS §6.2; CS §14.3 'envelope_algorithm_unsupported'.

description: CONTRACT_SPEC.md §6.5 step 3: an envelope with a valid magic but an unsupported version byte (0x02) rejects with VersionError 'envelope_version_unsupported' before the alg_id check.
notes: version 0x02 is a future incompatible layout per CS §6.1:330; CS §14.3 'envelope_version_unsupported'.
